method:
DLL wheat-worker replay with explicit synthetic walking; never opens a process.

Requires the Dashboard production-static research harness, its Python libraries,
and the SHA-256-pinned DLL. The original worker, farm update, crop/task selector,
yield, return helper and animation-clock instructions execute in Unicorn.
Pathfinding, movement, storage capacity, graphics and rest integration are
isolated assumptions. Results are conditional estimates, not live validation.

fixture.dispatch_order: building, synthetic movement, unit clock, worker
fixture.startup: worker already assigned at home; no campfire journey
fixture.cohort_definition: 24 consecutive deposited wheat; 5 intervals after first cohort in full run
fixture.rate_unit: wheat per 3000 simulation ticks; real minute only at measured 50 TPS

clock_sequences.sow: no separate work sequence; crop written on arrival

limits: walking and BFS tie-breaking are synthetic, not the original native path/movement engine
empirical_switch is a 12-empty/16-loaded hypothesis, not a verified native U transition
only five repeat intervals; variable traces are sample averages, not proven infinite-horizon periods
zero_walk makes every route arrive on the next update, including internal field movement
d=0 co-locates access points as an abstract control; not a guaranteed buildable layout
the 3-farm empirical unit test stores scalar distances, not an original live tick trace/map
